subject: You must register an account using getAccountInfo prior to proceeding.

messages.author: c7f73300e7a29f6d
messages.subject: You must register an account using getAccountInfo prior to proceeding.
parts:
Hi All,
My app works fine when I run it in R-Studio, but after I deploy it and run it gives me an error.

2017-02-21T06:00:02.866371+00:00 shinyapps[158179]: Error in value[[3L]](cond) : 
2017-02-21T06:00:02.866374+00:00 shinyapps[158179]:   You must register an account using setAccountInfo prior to proceeding.
2017-02-21T06:00:02.866375+00:00 shinyapps[158179]: Calls: local ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous>
2017-02-21T06:00:02.866413+00:00 shinyapps[158179]: Execution halted

Please help someone.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: You must register an account using getAccountInfo prior to proceeding.
parts: You are calling setAccountInfo and deployApp in your ui.R. You cannot do that.
